Atlanta Airport (IATA: ATL, ICAO: KATL), also known as Hartsfield–Jackson Atlanta Inte, is the third largest airport in United States.It is an international airport and serves the area of Atlanta, United States.Atlanta Airport has non-stop passenger flights scheduled to 242 destinations in 54 countries.
